target.title: refactor(pairing): store channel pairing state in SQLite
target.body:
Closes #105761

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where channel pairing requests and approved-sender allowlists remained live JSON state under the credentials directory. Runtime reads also continued merging a legacy unscoped allowlist, so pairing was the remaining non-migration exception to SQLite-only runtime state.

## Why This Change Was Made

Pairing requests and account-scoped allowlists now use the existing shared SQLite tables and synchronous write transactions. Startup migration and `openclaw doctor --fix` import recognizable legacy JSON files, resolve effective channel defaults through channel contracts, and remove a source only after a successful transactional merge; unreadable, unresolved, or ambiguous files remain in place with a warning. The deprecated SDK path helper remains available only for migration compatibility.

## User Impact

Pairing approvals and pending requests now have one canonical SQLite owner. Existing recognized JSON state migrates automatically without losing concurrent changes or crossing channel/account boundaries, while ambiguous legacy filenames fail closed for operator review.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxcbbnmwqvtr6kwevbqsdcsv` (`swift-lobster-1c1c`)
- `pnpm test src/pairing/pairing-store.test.ts src/infra/state-migrations.channel-pairing.test.ts src/infra/state-migrations.test.ts src/commands/doctor-state-migrations.test.ts` — 141 tests passed
- `pnpm test src/pairing/pairing-store-keys.test.ts src/plugins/contracts/plugin-sdk-subpaths.test.ts src/plugin-sdk/channel-pairing.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/state-migrations.test.ts` — 32 tests passed
- `pnpm check:changed -- <touched files>` — formatting, SDK API/export gates, core/test/extension typechecks, full core/extension lint, database-first guard, import-cycle checks, and pairing guards passed
- Post-review focused core/test typechecks, lint, database-first guard, and pairing guards passed after the final migration safety fixes
- Fresh autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings
